name: halcyon
description: Halcyon monorepo: Next.js web app (web/) and Express API (api/)

scripts.install:all: npm install --no-package-lock && npm ci --prefix api && npm ci --prefix web
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix api && npm run build --prefix web
scripts.admin:create: docker compose exec api sh docker-entrypoint.sh node dist/db/create-admin.js
